description: Test whether the Atm knockout mouse recapitulates the human ataxia-telangiectasia phenotype spectrum
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, json, collections, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

base="https://www.alliancegenome.org/api"
res=requests.get(f"{base}/gene/MGI:107202/phenotypes", params={"limit":300}, timeout=50).json()["results"]
mp=[]
for x in res:
    mp.append({"statement":x["phenotypeStatement"],
               "pmids":[c["referencedCurie"] for c in (x.get("pubmedPublications") or [])]})
mdf=pd.DataFrame(mp).drop_duplicates("statement")
print("unique mouse Atm phenotype statements:", len(mdf), "from", len({p for l in mdf.pmids for p in l}), "publications")

# --- human A-T HPO categories (ontology.jax.org, OMIM:208900) ---
hj=requests.get("https://ontology.jax.org/api/network/annotation/OMIM:208900", timeout=50).json()
hcats={k:[t["name"] for t in v] for k,v in hj["categories"].items() if v}
print("\nhuman A-T HPO systems:", len(hcats), "terms:", sum(len(v) for v in hcats.values()))

# --- map both onto shared organ-system buckets by keyword ---
BUCKETS = {
 "Nervous system":      r"ataxia|cerebell|purkinje|neuro|nerve|brain|motor|tremor|seizure|dystonia|gait|coordinat|myelin|behavi|dysarthr|nystagm",
 "Immune system":       r"immun|lymphocyt|thymus|thymocyt|T cell|B cell|igg|iga|antibod|spleen|leukocyt|infect|hematopoiet|haematopoiet",
 "Neoplasm":            r"tumor|tumour|lymphoma|neoplas|carcinom|cancer|leukemia|leukaemia",
 "Eye / telangiectasia":r"telangiect|ocul|eye|conjunctiv|retina|cornea|lens|cataract",
 "Growth / body size":  r"growth|body size|body weight|body length|runt|emaciat|lean|adipose|weight",
 "Reproductive system": r"infertil|gonad|ovar|testis|testic|sperm|meiot|meiosis|oocyte|germ cell|reproduc",
 "Endocrine / metabolic":r"insulin|glucose|diabet|metaboli|thyroid|endocrin|lipid|cholesterol|hormone",
 "Cardiovascular":      r"heart|cardiac|vascul|aort|blood pressure|atheroscler",
 "Mortality / lifespan":r"lethal|mortalit|lifespan|premature death|survival|aging|ageing",
 "Cellular / DNA damage":r"chromosom|dna damage|radiosensit|apoptosis|cell cycle|telomer|genomic instab|micronucle|oxidative|senescen",
 "Skin / integument":   r"skin|hair|coat|pigment|graying|greying",
 "Skeletal / muscular": r"bone|skelet|muscle|muscul|myopath|kyphos",
}
def bucket(txt):
    t=txt.lower(); hits=[b for b,p in BUCKETS.items() if re.search(p,t)]
    return hits or ["Other"]

mcount=collections.Counter()
for s in mdf.statement: 
    for b in bucket(s): mcount[b]+=1
hcount=collections.Counter()
hterm_bucket={}
for cat,terms in hcats.items():
    for t in terms:
        for b in bucket(cat+" "+t): hcount[b]+=1

order=[b for b in BUCKETS]+["Other"]
cmp=pd.DataFrame({"mouse_Atm":[mcount.get(b,0) for b in order],
                  "human_AT_HPO":[hcount.get(b,0) for b in order]}, index=order)
cmp["mouse_frac"]=cmp.mouse_Atm/cmp.mouse_Atm.sum()
cmp["human_frac"]=cmp.human_AT_HPO/cmp.human_AT_HPO.sum()
print("\n", cmp.to_string())

from scipy import stats
keep=cmp[(cmp.mouse_Atm+cmp.human_AT_HPO)>=3]
chi2,pv,dof,exp=stats.chi2_contingency(keep[["mouse_Atm","human_AT_HPO"]].T.values)
n=keep[["mouse_Atm","human_AT_HPO"]].values.sum()
V=np.sqrt(chi2/(n*(min(2,keep.shape[0])-1)))
rho,prho=stats.spearmanr(cmp.mouse_frac, cmp.human_frac)
print(f"\nchi2={chi2:.1f} df={dof} p={pv:.3e}  Cramer V={V:.3f}  n={n}")
print(f"Spearman mouse vs human system fractions: rho={rho:.3f} p={prho:.3f}")

# telangiectasia / Purkinje specifics
print("\nmouse statements matching telangiect:", [s for s in mdf.statement if "telangiect" in s.lower()])
print("mouse statements matching purkinje/cerebell/ataxia:", [s for s in mdf.statement if re.search("purkinje|cerebell|ataxia",s.lower())])
print("\nmouse neoplasm statements:", [s for s in mdf.statement if re.search("lymphoma|tumor|neoplas",s.lower())][:12])

# ---- figure ----
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(15,6))
ax=axes[0]
y=np.arange(len(order)); w=0.4
ax.barh(y+w/2, cmp.mouse_frac*100, w, color="#4878a8", label=f"Mouse Atm (n={cmp.mouse_Atm.sum()} MP)")
ax.barh(y-w/2, cmp.human_frac*100, w, color="#c44e52", label=f"Human A-T (n={cmp.human_AT_HPO.sum()} HPO)")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(order, fontsize=9); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlabel("Share of annotated phenotypes (%)")
ax.set_title(f"Mouse Atm model vs human A-T phenotype spectrum\nchi2={chi2:.0f}, p={pv:.1e}, Cramer V={V:.2f}", fontsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=9); ax.grid(axis="x", alpha=0.3)

ax2=axes[1]
od=pd.DataFrame({"species":["S. cerevisiae","C. elegans","D. melanogaster","D. rerio","X. tropicalis","X. laevis","M. musculus","R. norvegicus"],
                 "symbol":["TEL1","atm-1","tefu","atm","atm","atm.L","Atm","Atm"],
                 "matched":[3,2,6,1,8,1,10,10],"total":[9,9,9,10,9,1,10,10]})
od["pct"]=100*od.matched/od.total
ax2.barh(od.species, od.pct, color=["#999"]*6+["#4878a8"]*2)
for i,(m,t) in enumerate(zip(od.matched,od.total)):
    ax2.text(100*m/t+1.5, i, f"{m}/{t}", va="center", fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xlabel("Orthology prediction methods in agreement (%)")
ax2.set_title("ATM orthologue support across model species\n(Alliance of Genome Resources, all best-reciprocal)", fontsize=11)
ax2.set_xlim(0,118); ax2.grid(axis="x", alpha=0.3)
for i,s in enumerate(od.symbol): ax2.text(2, i, s, va="center", fontsize=9, style="italic", color="white", fontweight="bold")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
